items.title: Hono: `csrf()` does not check requests sent by hyperlink auditing (`text/ping`)
items.snippet: `csrf()` validates a request only when its `Content-Type` is one of the three types an HTML form can send. Chromium's hyperlink auditing (` `) sends a cross-origin POST with the user's cookies and the content type `text/ping`, which is not in that list. The middleware does not look at `Origin` or `Sec-Fetch-Site` for such a request, so it is passed to the handler. The middleware skips the origin…
items.summary: Hono's `csrf()` middleware fails to check `text/ping` requests sent via hyperlink auditing, potentially bypassing CSRF protection in Node.js apps. Upgrade hono to 4.13.16 or later.

items.title: Hono: `validator('form')` skips validation for `multipart/form-data` requests with extra parameters
items.snippet: `validator('form')` only recognizes a `multipart/form-data` `Content-Type` that carries nothing but a single `boundary` parameter. A request with another legal parameter, such as `charset`, or with extra whitespace after the `;` is not recognized as a form. items.summary: Hono's `validator('form')` skips validation for `multipart/form-data` requests carrying extra parameters or whitespace, potentially bypassing input validation. Upgrade hono to 4.13.16 or later.

items.title: Soup Sieve: Polynomial-time denial of service in the descendant combinator
items.snippet: Matching a selector that uses the descendant combinator (`a b`) takes time that grows polynomially with how deeply the document is nested, and each extra descendant combinator in the selector raises the degree by one. A selector with `k` descendant combinators takes `O(n^(k+1))` time on a chain of `n` nested elements. An attacker who controls the HTML or XML that an application passes to Soup Sie…
items.summary: Soup Sieve in Python suffers from a polynomial-time denial of service vulnerability in the descendant combinator, affecting applications parsing deeply nested untrusted HTML. Upgrade soupsieve to 4.0.0 or later.

items.title: Soup Sieve: General sibling combinator inside :has() matches untrusted HTML in quadratic time
items.snippet: Matching a selector that puts a general-sibling combinator inside `:has()`, such as `div:has(a ~ b)`, against untrusted HTML runs in O(n²) time in the number of sibling elements. A single small document with a few thousand siblings ties the process up for a minute of CPU, so an application that runs a fixed selector of this shape over HTML it doesn't control can be stalled by one request. `:has`…
items.summary: Soup Sieve in Python has a quadratic time denial of service vulnerability when matching general sibling combinators inside `:has()` against untrusted HTML, affecting applications processing untrusted documents. Upgrade soupsieve to 2.10.0 or later.
